title: Purely Performance
description: A modpacked made purely for performance!
body:
# Purely Performance
 
### Purpose
Purely Performance is a modpack that tries to squeeze as much performance as possible whilst being as light-weight as possible.

### Mod Purposes
All mods here aim to improve and optimize certain parts of the game. Some mods here are additonial. 

Some mods aren't necessary for all players. So feel free to remove the following mods...

- "FPS Overlay" -> Once you have tested the modpack to see the performance boost. 

- "Very Many Players (Fabric)" -> if you're going to play single player only you won't need this mod.


### Uses
Feel free to use this modpack as a base for any of your own modpacks, public or private.
